summary: @servicetitan/hammer-icon preinstall executes obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun runtime
details: Package publishes as an SVG icon set (package.json `files` allowlist declares only `mdi/{filled,outlined,round,sharp,two-tone}/*.svg` and CHANGELOG.md) but ships two undeclared files, `setup.mjs` and a 727KB `math_init.js`, and wires them to a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the `bun` binary in a tempdir, then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])` at install time. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated blob (obfuscator.io-style shuffled numeric/string array plus a rotating dispatcher `function WV8StW(... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())...)`, hex-named identifiers, 2-letter helper functions) whose content is unrelated to the SVG icon purpose the package advertises and is not human-inspectable. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on `npm install` under a runtime the icon package has no reason to require, and both payload files are smuggled past the manifest's declared `files` allowlist.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
